51584.meaning1: to the great; for the great; for the large
51584.meaning2: to the great; for the great; for the large

examples.text: ko nu kho hetu ko paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāyā'ti?

51585.grammar: adj, masc & nt gen sg of mahanta
51585.meaning1: of the great; of the large

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, issāso vā issās'antevāsī vā tiṇapurisarūpake vā mattikāpuñje vā yoggaṃ karitvā, so aparena samayena dūrepātī ca hoti akkhaṇavedhī ca mahato ca kāyassa padāletā.

taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gāmaṇi, api nu so puriso mahato janakāyassa āyācanahetu vā thomanahetu vā pañjalikā anuparisakkanahetu vā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjeyyā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.
idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo bhāvitakāyo hoti bhāvitasīlo bhāvitacitto bhāvitapañño aparitto mahatto appamāṇavihārī.
yasmā ca saṅgahā ete, samavekkhanti paṇḍitā, tasmā mahattaṃ papponti, pāsaṃsā ca bhavanti te'ti.
ko sutvā nappasīdeyya, api kaṇh'ābhijātiyo, tasmā hi attakāmena, mahattam'abhikaṅkhatā, saddhammo garukātabbo, saraṃ buddhāna'sāsanan'ti.

51588.grammar: nt, abstr, from mahā, in comps (+loc)

examples.text: tīhi, bhikkhave, aṅgehi samannāgato pāpaṇiko nacirass'eva mahattaṃ vepullattaṃ pāpuṇāti bhogesu. katamehi tīhi?
kā ca, bhikkhave, sappurisānaṃ gati? devamahattatā vā manussamahattatā vā'ti.

51590.meaning1: aspiration for greatness; desire for illustriousness

examples.text: tasmā hi attakāmena, mahattam'abhikaṅkhatā, saddhammo garukātabbo, saraṃ buddhāna sāsanan'ti.
mātugāmo nāma manuss'itthī, na yakkhī na petī, na tiracchānagatā. antamaso tadahujātā'pi dārikā, pag'eva mahattarī.

51592.grammar: adj, fem nom sg of mahattara, compar of mahatī (+abl)

examples.text: mātugāmo nāma manuss'itthī, na yakkhī na petī, na tiracchānagatā. antamaso tadahujātā'pi dārikā, pag'eva mahattarī.

n'eva satimaṃ kalaṃ upeti na sahassimaṃ kalaṃ upeti na satasahassimaṃ kalaṃ upeti purimaṃ dukkhakkhandhaṃ parikkhīṇaṃ pariyādiṇṇaṃ upanidhāya yadidaṃ sattakkhattuṃparamatā. evaṃ mah'atthiyo kho, bhikkhave, dhamm'ābhisamayo, evaṃ mah'atthiyo dhammacakkhupaṭilābho'ti.

51595.synonym: aḍḍha, aḍḍhī, adalidda, adaḷidda, dhanavant, bhogavant, bhogī, vittavant, sadhana
51595.commentary: (SNa) nidhānagataṃ muttasār'ādi mahantaṃ dhanam'etesan'ti mahaddhanā. (ANa) mahaddhanā'ti vaḷañjanakadhanena mahaddhanā.

examples.text: vāṇijo'va bhayaṃ maggaṃ, appasattho mahaddhano, visaṃ jīvitu'kāmo'va, pāpāni parivajjaye.

idha, bhikkhave, ekacco aḍḍho hoti mahaddhano mahābhogo. evarūpo, bhikkhave, aḍḍhakahāpaṇena'pi na bandhanaṃ nigacchati, kahāpaṇena'pi na bandhanaṃ nigacchati, kahāpaṇasatena'pi na bandhanaṃ nigacchati.

51598.meaning1: big; great; large; grand; vast; extensive
51598.synonym: uḷāra, oḷāra, bahu, braha, brahanta, brahā, bhūri, mahatī, mahantaka, mahantī, mahalla, mahallaka, mahallikā, mahā, vipula, visāla

examples.text: eko ahaṃ sakka mahantam'oghaṃ, anissito no visahāmi tārituṃ, ārammaṇaṃ brūhi samantacakkhu, yaṃ nissito ogham'imaṃ tareyyaṃ.
tena kho pana samayena āyasmā udāyī mahatiyā gihiparisāya parivuto dhammaṃ desento nisinno hoti.

51599.meaning1: great; powerful; mighty; eminent; distinguished; noble
51599.synonym: ariya, ugga, ucca, pavara, balasampanna, bhusa, mahatī, mahantī, mahā

examples.text: saṃvar'atthaṃ pahān'atthaṃ, brahmacariyaṃ anītihaṃ, adesayi so bhagavā, nibbān'ogadhagāminaṃ, esa maggo mahantehi, anuyāto mah'esibhi.
